_doc: Where each part of the guide works today, and why (Yohann, 16 Nov 2026: 'For each module that we're building, we should also say in which country it's available'). The one list in the code: modules by the conversation that owns them (MODULE-CONVERSATIONS.md, 1 to 14, in that order), each with its parts. A part: id, name, where ('any', or a list of ISO country codes where it works), why (the source or rule that ties it, in one sentence), and for a part tied to countries, needs (what would make it work in another country, in one sentence: the owner's page shows it when a country is prepared). 'any' means no country rule was found in the code or the docs: nothing has been tried outside Spain yet. countries: the countries the owner's modules page shows first. Read by that page (onboarding-site/modules/, through its build's copy); the owner's switches are kept in the database (table module_switches) and win over this list. Not read by the maker or the generator yet (engine/src/modules/README.md, 'Not built yet'). A module's README says the same in words under 'Where it is available': change both together.

parts.name: Taxis found near the house
parts.why: From our open directory (Overture), which covers the world; numbers are written the Spanish way only for Spanish numbers. A taxi the host types works anywhere.

parts.name: Ride apps
parts.why: Uber, Cabify, Bolt and Freenow are looked up among Spain's cities only.
parts.needs: The ride apps that work in the country and the cities each one serves.

parts.name: Train stations and lines
parts.why: Stations, lines and journey times come from Renfe's open timetable files. A station added by its name or link works anywhere.
parts.needs: The country's open train timetables, read into our stations file as Renfe's are.

parts.name: iryo and Ouigo
parts.why: Looked up only among our high speed stations, which are Spain's.
parts.needs: The country's other train companies, if it has any, and where they stop.

parts.name: Metro, tram and bus stops
parts.why: From the open timetables of Spain's national access point. A stop added by its name or link works anywhere.
parts.needs: The country's open timetables for metro, tram and bus: its national access point, or each city's own files.

parts.name: Home's tiles and sizes
parts.why: Drawn from the guide's own sections: no country rule.

parts.name: The white cards
parts.why: The host's own places with their hours: no country rule.

parts.name: Arranging Home in the maker
parts.why: The board moves what the guide has: no country rule.

parts.name: Guide sections
parts.why: Switches a section on or off: no country rule.

parts.name: Markets found for the host
parts.why: The research is Spain only for now (the product's rule), and a weekly market is the Spanish case.
parts.needs: The research told what a market is in that country and where its markets are listed.

parts.name: Markets the host adds
parts.why: The host's own words, days and hours: no country rule.

parts.name: What's on
parts.why: An agenda of the guide's own markets and events: no country rule.

parts.name: Events found and kept up to date
parts.why: The research is Spain only for now; the search and the kinds of event are tuned for Spain's traditions.
parts.needs: The search told the country's own traditions and kinds of event.

parts.name: The host's own events
parts.why: Typed by the host: no country rule.

parts.name: The host's own list
parts.why: The host's words; Google only locates the place.

parts.name: A place's hours, phone and website
parts.why: Read from our open directory and the place's own website with Spain's towns and Spain's usual seasons; shared with Things to do and Nightlife.
parts.needs: The country's towns (GeoNames' file for it) and its usual seasons.

parts.name: Google's open-now line
parts.why: Google's own live card for a place that has a Google id: no country rule.

parts.name: Places the host adds
parts.why: The host's words; Google only locates the place.

parts.name: The swipe deck
parts.why: Google's places near the house, shown live: no country limit found in the code.

parts.name: Towns as things to do
parts.why: The list of towns is made from GeoNames' file for Spain.
parts.needs: GeoNames' file for the country, made into our list of towns.

parts.name: Research and Find more
parts.why: The research is Spain only for now (the product's rule).
parts.needs: The research told what to look for in that country.

parts.name: Photos, rooms and beds
parts.why: From the listing and the host: no country rule.

parts.name: What the place offers
parts.why: One list in six languages with Airbnb's codes: no country rule.

parts.name: Reading the listing
parts.why: Airbnb, Booking.com and Vrbo pages are read whatever the country.

parts.name: Bins and collection days
parts.why: The host tells us, nothing is researched. The sentences we suggest name Spain's container colours.

parts.name: Emergency numbers and services found
parts.why: The research is Spain only for now: the emergency number, the health line and the services near the house.
parts.needs: The country's emergency number, its health line and the services the research should look for.

parts.name: Contacts the host adds
parts.why: Typed by the host: no country rule.

parts.name: The host's own list
parts.why: The host's words, as Eat and drink; a place's facts come as Restaurants' do.

parts.name: The house guide, arrival, extras
parts.why: The host's own words: no country rule.

parts.name: The Wi-Fi sheet and its code
parts.why: A standard Wi-Fi code made from the name and the password: no country rule.

parts.name: The map and its pins
parts.why: OpenFreeMap's tiles cover the world.

parts.name: Search on the map
parts.why: Photon's open search, around the house: no country rule.

parts.name: Logo, cover and colours
parts.why: The six colour worlds and the one made from the host's picture: no country rule.
